subject: TRY FOREVER heartbeat native persistent-selection owner lifecycle
findings: The previous owner probe treated collection semantics as a per-light construction side effect. That shape could rewrite collection delegates repeatedly while building children and did not prove selected CollectionItemInfo metadata refreshed after later selection changes.
Probe v2 correctly moves source proof to collection lifecycle owners: after row construction and after persistent selection refresh. A per-light-only counterfeit is explicitly PARTIAL_UNSAFE.
The proposed owner patch composes the existing HeartbeatSelectionAccessibilityPolicy into the sole OperatorOverlayService and does not request keyboard or accessibility focus.
The patch uses the already accepted model plus semantic selected id, so discarded attempted heartbeat controls are not promoted into current collection items.
CollectionInfo/CollectionItemInfo source shapes are compatible with the current minSdk contract, but their presence is not runtime TalkBack evidence.
No operator-visible topology changed in this pulse; mutating Warm Walls/Christmas motion would be decorative theater and correctly stayed dark.
